text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
There were so many buono things, it was so much fun.
Watermelon, summer veggies, somen noodles...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Still, there's no reason to feel lonely, right?
Because—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Because autumn is even more amazing!
Roasted sweet potatoes, matsutake mushrooms, grape picking!
Seasoned rice and salted grilled saury...!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's gonna be just as buono and fun as summer!
I can't wait~!
As a Trainer, I was hoping for some feedback beyond just the food, but—

That, too, is just part of her personality. Regardless,
and just like that, our passionate summer training camp came to an end.
